Don't forget to change the sprite on the right side of the sensing block to use your player sprite.  Make sure the left side is the "name" variable.

If left unchanged, your player will not participate!

%O(j2_LH%u;9YZKn6.:^.text: When making your player, create a corresponding marker for it. Make sure it has the same number in its sprite name as your player's number in their sprite name. Then, fix up the sensing blocks here so they match the ones displayed in the Player0 sprite (but don't set the parts on the right side to Marker0).
